# T-1: Strictify test selection

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make the runner parse one valid selection and reject invalid selector input before discovery.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R1 distinguishes single-valued suite selectors from the retained multi-valued file union.
- R2 emits the bounded versioned resolver-backed JSON contract without execution.
- Valid existing selectors retain their execution behavior.

## Implementation Notes
Extend the existing runner/helper boundary with a TestSelection value class; keep usage and JSON listing separate from execution while sharing one resolver with depth 32, 10000-file, 4096-character path, and 16 MiB JSON limits.

## Test Strategy
Add spec-local and shared unit/CLI regressions for valid file unions, unknown/conflicting/duplicate suite selectors, missing values, help, exact JSON listing, and every resolver/output limit.
